answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in juniper and orchard lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the lagoon graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 711 impostors cost 1491 times the honest price and take 29 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
